capabilities: Create notes from emails sent to a private ingestion address
Fetch emails manually, on a schedule, or on vault open
Save attachments following Obsidian's attachment location setting
Generate unique filenames so new notes never overwrite existing files
Verify the API key connection from plugin settings
disambiguation: Not an email client inside Obsidian; you send mail from your own email app to a private address, then the plugin fetches it into the vault.
extras: Freemium: free trial with paid upgrade plans. Emails on the server are automatically deleted after 72 hours. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Upcoming features (multiple vault support) are listed but not available.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture content sent by email into a vault.

relations.evidence: Requires an Email2Obsidian account and API key.

summary: Email-capture service that turns emails sent to a private address into fully formatted Obsidian notes, including subject, body, and attachments.
